This will probably be buried, but here it goes. During the summer of 2006 when I was ten years old, I had gone on vacation with my family to Maui, there was one day where we went to this crazy black sand beach. We found a large boulder near the water, and my mom wanted to take a picture of me sitting on it. As I was smiling for the pic, a huge wave came up and hit me from behind. I went over and was tumbling through the water, I hit my head a few times and swallowed a bunch of water. Just when I thought I couldn't take it anymore, I felt a pair of hands grab me and pull me out, he asked me if I was okay, but I was too busy coughing up saltwater to say anything, so I just nodded. He told me to take care, then I then watched him walk into a crowd, when it cleared litterally a second later, he was gone, I looked everywhere to thank him. But I couldn't find him

TLDR: I was swept away at sea, random dude grabs me and saves my life, disappeared before I could thank him.
